text:
Alex: Quick heads-up — planning to cut v2.14.0 tomorrow. Need coordinated bumps across api, runtime, console, and sdks. Cutoff currently 10:00am PT.
Priya: Ack. I'll open runtime bump PRs and start CI. ETA ~3h.
Jon: Console is green besides the changelog entry. Can someone paste the final release notes line we want?
Maria: Drafting the notes now. There's a KV cache behavior tweak that needs a short migration note — tagging @docs.
docs-bot: docs: assigned @Lina to write the KV cache migration blurb.
Lina: Got it, drafting. Maria — can you confirm the recommended mitigation for clients?
Alex: Important reminder: runtime and api must be identical minor versions for ABI safety. Do not merge SDK PRs until tags propagate. For pre-release testing, use tag: `v2.14.0-rc1`.
Jon: Can we do a quick smoke run after runtime merges? I can run console e2e in staging.
buildbot: runtime-ci (PR #452) status: failure — unit test failing: `test_kv_eviction.py`
Priya: On the failing test — looks like quantization path edge case. I'm patching now.
Sarah: If runtime CI can't be green by cutoff, propose fallback: pin console to v2.13.x and delay SDK bump. Any objections?
Alex: Let's avoid pinning unless necessary. Proposal: extend cutoff to 12:00pm PT if runtime CI is green by 11:30. @Sarah can you approve extension?
Sarah: :thumbsup: I approve extension conditional on a passing CI by 11:30.
Priya: Patch pushed, CI retriggered — ETA ~25m.
buildbot: runtime-ci (PR #452) rerun: passing ✅
Jon: Ran console e2e against `v2.14.0-rc1` runtime — all clear, merging changelog and tagging console `v2.14.0`.
Alex: Merge checklist (leaving here so it's visible):
- Merge runtime PRs
- Merge api bump PR
- Merge console changelog + tag
- Tag SDKs (wait for tags to appear in registry)
- Final release notes + announcement
(Reminder: use `git tag -a v2.14.0 -m "release v2.14.0" && git push origin v2.14.0` for tagging)
Maria: Final release notes drafted and pushed to the release-notes repo. Included KV cache note and migration tip.
Lina: Docs PR #789 up with the KV cache migration steps — requesting review from @docs-team.
Sarah: All set from release coordination. I'll send the release announcement once tags propagate and SDKs are published.
Alex: Thanks everyone — I'll post a final merge window 30m before the cut. If anything blocks, ping this thread. :handshake:
